Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are out in the middle. Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma are the openers for India Women. Udeshika Prabodhani will start with the ball. Let's go!

A powerful start but a disappointing finish for Sri Lanka Women, but it's the opposite for India Women, and they would be the happier side going into this break. It's been a terrific recovery for Harmanpreet Kaur and her troops. They have pulled things back together exceptionally well and have restricted Sri Lanka to a below-par score. After electing to bat first, Sri Lanka Women got off to a positive start as the openers, Vishmi Gunaratne and Chamari Atapattu stitched together 87 runs and were cruising away. However, Chamari Atapattu perished after scoring 43 runs and post that wickets started to tumble like a pack of cards. All of a sudden, Sri Lanka Women from 87 for 0 became 120 for 7 and failed to put a healthy total on the board. They would be disappointed with the total, especially after the start they got. For India Women, it was their skipper who was the pick of the bowlers, she grabbed a wicket in her spell of 3 overs and gave away just 13 runs. But in the end, it was a collective performance, as they took 7 wickets for 33 runs. India Women have an opportunity here to seal the series. Stay tuned for the chase!
Another couple as this is guided through point. SRI LANKA END WIH 125!
Two more! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for two.
Another single as this is hit to covers.
OUT! TAKEN! This is hit to mid off, uppishly and it is an easy catch to Smriti Mandhana!
Commentary.Howout: c Smriti Mandhana b Renuka Singh

Commentary.Commentary: On middle, this is pushed to mid on for one.
On middle, this is played through mid-wicket for two.
Excellent comeback from India Women. They have taken things perfectly under control. Can Sri Lanka Women make the over a big one? We will find out. Anushka Sanjeewani will face the first ball.
Renuka Singh to bowl the final over of the innings.
On off, this is pushed to mid off for one.
OUT! TAKEN! On middle, Oshadi Ranasinghe looks to play the reverse sweep again, this is slower through the air and hence, she is through the shot early, it goes off the glove and the keeper takes it.
Commentary.Howout: c Yastika Bhatia b Radha Yadav

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! The reverse sweep comes out, it is hit over point for a boundary.
On off, this is pushed to cover for one.
The reverse sweep comes out, it goes towards point for one.

OUT! THE BATTER IS JUST SHORT! Shafali Verma with yet another good work in the field! Outside off, this is played towards short third man. They go for one. Shafali Verma gets to the ball and fires it to the keeper who whips the bails off. It is referred and replays show that the batter is just short.
Run out chance! There is a throw at the keeper's end! The replay shows that Hasini Perera is just short of her crease. She did put in a dive there, but that could not save her. OUT it is!
Hasini Perera comes to the crease.

OUT! THIS TIME THE FINGER IS RAISED! Another one bites the dust! Nilakshi de Silva steps out, Sharma bowls a yorker on middle, she tries to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pad. An appeal and the finger is raised again.

That looked out! Full and on middle, Kavisha Dilhari looks to sweep but misses. She gets hit on the pad. An appeal but turned down. A single taken as it rolls on the leg side. No signal from the umpire so he might have felt there was bat.
A yorker now on off, this is jammed out to the bowler.
Direct hit and it would have been another wicket! A full ball, it is hit to mid off. The batter go for one. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Nilakshi de Silva walks out to bat.

OUT! TAKEN! That is a stunner! Shorter and outside off, Harshitha Madavi cuts but uppishly to the right of the cover fielder. Shafali Verma dives to her right and takes it brilliantly. Sri Lanka Women falling apart now.
Commentary.Howout: c Shafali Verma b Deepti Sharma

Commentary.Commentary: Two more! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for two.
Kavisha Dilhari comes to the crease.

OUT! TAKEN! Kaur gets her revenge! This is shorter and on middle, Vishmi Gunaratne hits it but straight back to Kaur who takes a simple catch. She throws the ball onto the ground in anger. Maybe still upset over the misfield. A good little innings from Vishmi Gunaratne. She was probably exhausted as that was a tired looking shot.
FOUR! Misfield and that will help Sri Lanka! That should have been stopped! On the pads, this is swept back towards short fine leg. The fielder lets it through her legs. Kaur is not happy at all.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
Two more now! On the pads, this is swept behind on the leg side for two.

FOUR BYES! That has missed everything! Short and angling into the body. Harshitha Madavi looks to pull but this one stays low, goes under the bat and the keeper fails to take it too. It races to the fine leg fence. Welcome boundary. Lanka won't mind how they come as long as they do.
Yes, she does! A dot to end, on middle, Vishmi Gunaratne swings, she gets an inside edge onto the pads.
On the pads, this is worked through square leg for just another single. Can Pooja end the over well now?
On middle, Vishmi Gunaratne looks to go over cover but it goes off the inner half towards mid-wicket for one.
On middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket for only one.
On middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket for only one.
Fuller and on middle, this is worked down to long on for one.
Single to end the over! On the pads, fullish ball. Harshitha Madavi flicks it to mid-wicket for a run.
Spinning away, outside off, tad shorter. Harshitha Madavi guides it towards short third man.
Outside off, shorter one. Vishmi Gunaratne cuts it past point for a single.
Leg bye! Loopy one, slower through the air, full, on middle. Harshitha Madavi misses her sweep. The ball hits her near her stomach and goes towards third man. Leg bye taken!
Tad shorter, outside off. Harshitha Madavi pushes it off the back foot towards cover.
Tosses this one up, outside off. Harshitha Madavi pushes this one towards cover.
A length ball, angling in, on the pads. Vishmi Gunaratne misses her flick and she gets hit on her pads.

OUT! TAKEN! Finally, India Women have managed to break this opening stand! Pooja Vastrakar draws first blood. Chamari Atapattu departs after a good start. A length ball, around middle and leg. Chamari Atapattu heaves this towards deep square leg. Nothing wrong with that shot, but unfortunately she finds the fielder placed there. Radha Yadav takes an easy catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Radha Yadav b Pooja Vastrakar

Commentary.Commentary: Well bowled! A length ball, shaping away, outside off. Chamari Atapattu hangs back and tries to cut this one but she misses.
Pooja Vastrakar takes all the pace off this one, serves a fuller one, outside off. Vishmi Gunaratne knocks it down to long off for a single.
On the pads now, length ball. Vishmi Gunaratne flicks it towards the fielder at short fine leg.
Tad shorter, around middle and off. Vishmi Gunaratne pulls bur finds the fielder at mid-wicket.
Tighter line now, around off, short in length. Vishmi Gunaratne pushes it towards mid-wicket and takes a single.
Spinning in, short in length, outside off. Vishmi Gunaratne hangs back and defends it out.
Loopy one, full, on middle. Chamari Atapattu sweeps this one towards the fielder at deep mid-wicket. Single taken!
Back of a length, outside off. Chamari Atapattu blocks it out off the back foot.
Beaten! Fuller now, tossed up, spinning away, outside off. Chamari Atapattu leans to drive but she misses.
Shorter from over the wicket, outside off. Vishmi Gunaratne cuts it towards deep point for a single.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Sri Lanka Women are cruising here! Full, on the pads. Chamari Atapattu flicks it past mid-wicket for a boundary.
FOUR! Glorious! Full, outside off. Chamari Atapattu presses forward and creams her drive through cover for a boundary.
Length, outside off. Chamari Atapattu cuts that one but she misses.

Wide! Missed opportunity a tough chance though! A length ball, down the leg side. Chamari Atapattu steps down and tries to flick this but she misses. Yastika Bhatia dives to her right, collects the ball with her right hand and throw's it at the stumps, but she misses.
Slower ball, full in length, around off. Vishmi Gunaratne heaves this one high over mid on. She gets more height than distance on that one. Only a single.
On the pads now, length ball. Chamari Atapattu whips it to the fielder at deep square leg. Another single!
Angling in on a fuller length, around middle. Vishmi Gunaratne makes room and pushes this from the inner half of her bat towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Nicely done! Short and width on offer. Chamari Atapattu slashes this one past the diving cover-point for a boundary. 11 runs off the over!
Nicely tossed up, yorker-length delivery, around middle. Chamari Atapattu blocks it out. An appeal for LBW there, but turned down. The bowler thought that hit the pad first.
FOUR! Poor delivery and punished! A low full toss, outside off. Chamari Atapattu drives it past cover for a boundary.
Another single! Tosses it up, slower again, around middle. Vishmi Gunaratne works it away towards mid-wicket and gets across to the other end.
Another loopy delivery, pitched up again, around off. Chamari Atapattu knocks it down to long off for a single.
Slower through the air, very full, around middle and leg. Vishmi Gunaratne flicks it towards deep mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Was that a chance? It would have been a stunner! Outside off, this is hit hard towards cover. Simran Bahadur dives forward and looks to take it inches above the ground but can't hold on.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled towards fine leg for one.
Really good fielding! Kept that to one! On the pads, this is whipped towards deep backward square leg. Jemimah Rodrigues runs to her left and keeps it down to one.
On middle, good comeback! Chamari Atapattu stays back and blocks.
FOUR! Nice and fine! On the pads, Chamari Atapattu pulls, it goes off the inner half and down to the fine leg fence. Welcome boundary.
Another length ball, Vishmi Gunaratne pushes it through covers and takes one.
On middle, Vishmi Gunaratne works it through mid-wicket and takes one.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Vishmi Gunaratne looks to flick but misses.
On middle, this is chipped down to long on for one.
On the pads, Chamari Atapattu swings again but misses to get hit on the pads. A loud appeal but turned down.
Quick run! On off, this is pushed to mid off for one.
Fuller and on off, this is firmly hit down to long off but only one.
Another dot! Shorter and outside off, Chamari Atapattu looks to cut but misses.
Leading edge but safe! Yet again, Chamari Atapattu looks to whip this over the leg side, this flies off the leading edge but over point for one.

A loud appeal from the keeper, the bowler though was not that interested! Length and outside off, Atapattu looks to heave it over the leg side. She misses. The sound was probably off the bat hitting the pad.
Goes back to bowling it around off, Chamari Atapattu guides it to point.
FOUR! That is a lovely shot! Trademark Chamari Atapattu! Full and on middle, this is heaved over the mid-wicket fielder for a boundary.
Length and around off, Chamari Atapattu guides it to point.
Right on the money to begin with! Length and on middle, defended.
Pooja Vastrakar comes into the attack.
This lands on off, turns away. Vishmi Gunaratne looks to push at it, it goes off the outer half to point. Another dot to end.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.

FOUR! A good effort but in vain! Really good shot, she had to hit that! On middle, Vishmi Gunaratne sweeps it behind square on the leg side. The fielder in the deep, runs to her right, dives but her effort goes in vain.
On the pads, Chamari Atapattu works it towards mid-wicket for one.
Steps out and gets to the pitch of the ball, she strokes it down to long on for one.
Well bowled! Slower through the air, it lands on off and turns away. Vishmi Gunaratne is beaten as she tries to defend.
Pitched up again, around middle. Chamari Atapattu plays it back to the bowler. Sri Lanka Women are 37 for 0 at the end of the Powerplay!
Fuller, around off. Chamari Atapattu pushes it towards cover.
FOUR! Swept away! Loopy ball, around middle. Chamari Atapattu gets down on her knee and sweeps it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Wide! Wide of off, shorter ball. Chamari Atapattu misses her cut once again. Wide called!
Width on offer now, tad shorter. Chamari Atapattu tries to cut this one but she misses.
SIX! BOOM! Tossed up ball, full, around middle. Chamari Atapattu dances down the track and tonks it straight down the ground for a biggie.
Wide! Wide of off, fuller ball. Chamari Atapattu tries to cut this away but she misses. Wide called!
Loopy ball, full, spinning in, outside off. Chamari Atapattu sweeps and misses.
Full, on middle. Vishmi Gunaratne nudges this one to mid-wicket.
Tosses this up, slower through the air, full. Chamari Atapattu sweeps it and the ball goes one bounce to the fielder at deep mid-wicket. One taken!
Full, on middle. Chamari Atapattu sweeps it to the fielder at square leg.
Another flighted delivery, outside off. Chamari Atapattu this time tries to reverse-sweep this but she misses.
Outside off, loopy ball, full. Chamari Atapattu tries to have a poke at it but she gets beaten.
Tosses this one up, very full, around middle. Vishmi Gunaratne flicks it towards mid on. The fielder there fimbles to stop the ball and the batters take a single.
Swing and a miss! Shaping away, length delivery, outside off. Chamari Atapattu hangs back and tries to slash this one but she misses.
Another length ball, outside off. Vishmi Gunaratne works it away towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! This is good aggression shown by Vishmi Gunaratne! A length ball, outside off. Vishmi Gunaratne heaves this over mid-wicket for aboundary. Second of the over!
On a length, around middle. Vishmi Gunaratne plays it back to the bowler off the back foot.
FOUR! Lovey shot! Simran Bahadur errs in line now, and serves it down the leg side, on a length. Vishmi Gunaratne gets down on her knee and swipes it past short fine leg for a boundary.
Simran Bahadur begins with a fullish ball, around off, hint of away movement. Vishmi Gunaratne drives it to the fielder at mid off.
Early change for India Women. Simran Bahadur comes into the attack.
Play and a miss! Good-length delivery, outside off. Chamari Atapattu stays in her crease and tries to cut this one but she fails to get any bat on it.
Back of a length, around middle and off. Chamari Atapattu steps down the track and blocks it out.
Leg bye! Angling this one in, on a length, on the pads. Vishmi Gunaratne misses her flick and the ball rolls towards fine leg off her pads. Leg bye taken!
Wide of off again, length ball. Vishmi Gunaratne pushes it off the back foot to the fielder at point.
FOUR! Top shot! Short and width on offer, Vishmi Gunaratne cuts it past point for a boundary.
Length ball, outside off. Vishmi Gunaratne blocks it off the back foot towards cover.
Flighted delivery, outside off, full in length. Vishmi Gunaratne pushes it wide of mid off and takes a quick single.
Full, around middle. Vishmi Gunaratne pushes it towards mid on.
Beaten now! Tad quicker, spinning away a tad, outside off. Vishmi Gunaratne gets beaten while trying to drive this one.
Very full, slower through the air, around middle. Vishmi Gunaratne drives and finds the fielder at mid off.
Loopy ball again, outside off, full in length. Vishmi Gunaratne looks to drive this but the ball goes off the outside edge towards third man for a brace.
MISFILED AND FOUR! Tosses this one up, full, outside off. Vishmi Gunaratne slices it towards point. Radha Yadav there fails to stop the ball, it goes through her towards the fence for a boundary.
Who will bowl from the other end? Deepti Sharma it is!
Fuller now, around off. Vishmi Gunaratne drives it towards cover and scampers across to the other end. Vishmi Gunaratne gets off the mark!
Swing and a miss! On a length, outside off, tailing back in. Vishmi Gunaratne looks to drive this but she misses and gets beaten on the inside edge.
Tad shorter, outside off. Vishmi Gunaratne pushes it towards cover.
Wide! Renuka Singh sprays this down the leg side. Vishmi Gunaratne tries to flick but she misses. Wide called! Sri Lanka Women are underway!
Pitched up this time, outside off. Vishmi Gunaratne drives straight down the ground. The fielder from mid on cuts it out. No run there!
Back of a length, outside off. Vishmi Gunaratne pushes it off the back foot towards cover.
Renuka Singh begins with a length ball, nipping in, around off. Vishmi Gunaratne stays in her crease and tries to push this away but the ball goes off the inside edge towards the leg side.

We are ready for action! The players are out in the middle. Chamari Atapattu and Vishmi Gunaratne will open the batting for Sri Lanka Women. Renuka Singh will begin the proceedings with the ball. Let's go!

Harmanpreet Kaur the captain of India Women says that they do not mind bowling first, it is a good opportunity for them to chase down the total. Informs that they have made two changes. Simran Bahadur comes in for Rajeshwari Gayakwad and Yastika Bhatia is in for Richa Ghosh.

Chamari Atapattu the skipper of Sri Lanka Women says that they will bat first, they have a pretty good batting lineup, in the previous game they did not click but they are looking forward on doing better this time. Informs that they have made one change.

PITCH REPORT - Gamini Perera is pitchside. He says that it's the same pitch as the previous game, there are little tiny cracks on this wicket, and the pitch is looking good for batting. Adds that the spinners will come into play once again. Informs that the captain winning the toss should bat first.

India Women (Playing XI) - Smriti Mandhana, Shafali Verma, Yastika Bhatia (WK) (In for Richa Ghosh), Jemimah Rodrigues, Harmanpreet Kaur (C)  Sabbhineni Meghana, Deepti Sharma, Simran Bahadur (In for Rajeshwari Gayakwad), Pooja Vastrakar, Renuka Singh, Radha Yadav.

Sri Lanka Women (Playing XI) - Chamari Atapattu (C), Vishmi Gunaratne, Harshitha Madavi, Hasini Perera (In for Ama Kanchana), Kavisha Dilhari, Nilakshi de Silva, Anushka Sanjeewani (WK), Oshadi Ranasinghe, Sugandika Kumari, Inoka Ranaweera, Udeshika Prabodhani.
TOSS - Sri Lanka Women have won the toss and they have elected to BAT first.

Like their opposition, even India Women were not at their best with the bat, but the bowlers were exceptional and they made sure the target set, was enough. Other than the win, another positive for India is that Jemimah Rodrigues got some runs under her belt on her return and she will be hoping she continues her good form. The tourists will be coming into this game high on confidence and will be aiming to secure the T20I series. Stay tuned for the toss and other updates.
